status: UNCONSTRAINED DESIGN EXPLORATION (canon set aside, physics kept). Collapsible main radiators for the v0.2 winning Wayfarer layout. Not canon, not engineering.

layout.note: same four cardinal roots on the 5 m root band as the repo placeholder

metric_heat_from_canon.source: CANON II v2.4 section 5 certified metric card
metric_heat_from_canon.rule: heat rejected = cold load + cryo electrical; cryo electrical scales with (T_reject - 20 K) at the same fraction of ideal efficiency as canon's 900 K numbers

emission.source: back-solved from canon: 24.04 MW over 719 m2 at 900 K implies 0.90 of blackbody

temperature_notes.1100: assumed refractory panels with sodium or lithium heat pipes
temperature_notes.1300: assumed carbon-carbon or niobium panels with lithium heat pipes; pushes cryo power up

torch.note: torch heat landing on the ship is an open hold in the repo; we report what each radiator can carry instead

RIGID.label: Hinged rigid panel
RIGID.how: one stiff panel swings out from flat against the hull; the repo placeholder
RIGID.limit_why: folds flat along the hull, so span is limited by free hull length

ACCORDION.label: Accordion fold
ACCORDION.how: stiff 2 m pleats fold zig-zag into a recess at the root and open one pleat at a time

TELESCOPE.label: Telescoping panels
TELESCOPE.how: nested panels slide out of a cassette inside the hull
TELESCOPE.limit_why: cassette depth inside the hull caps each section at 1.5 m

ROLLOUT.label: Roll-out membrane
ROLLOUT.how: flexible radiator sheet unrolls from a drum, held taut by edge booms
ROLLOUT.limit_why: edge boom length; sheet must be retracted for burns above about 2 g

DROPLET.label: Droplet sheet
DROPLET.how: a sheet of hot liquid-metal droplets sprayed from root to a collector on a boom
DROPLET.limit_why: boom length; any thrust blows the droplets off course, so coast and Metric only

assumption_notes: areal masses, span limits and g limits are authored estimates, not sourced figures
droplet and membrane radiators at 900-1300 K are speculative even for 2226
fin efficiency, view factors between radiators and the hull, and micrometeoroid margins are folded into the single 0.90 emissivity
